name: BC327
description: PNP complement to the BC337, common in audio driver/output stages and as a higher-current (-800mA) small-signal switch. TO-92 pinout is C-B-E (flat face toward you, leads down, left to right), like the rest of the European BC family. Values are magnitudes; PNP rails are negative.

pins.name: C
pins.description: collector (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: C-B-E left to right. Datasheets disagree on lead NUMBERING (Diotec/onsemi number the left lead pin 1 = C; multicomp/Farnell number the right lead pin 1 = E) but the physical layout is the same C-B-E.

typical_application: Audio driver and small output stages (paired with BC337), general switching up to 800mA, low-side and high-side small loads.
gotchas: pinout is C-B-E (European family), the REVERSE of American PNP parts like the 2N3906 (E-B-C)

datasheets number the leads inconsistently (Diotec/onsemi pin 1 = collector on the left; multicomp pin 1 = emitter on the right) even though the physical C-B-E layout is identical; when in doubt, meter it
PNP: all ratings are negative, do not read -45V as a positive limit
hFE depends on the -25 or -40 suffix; do not design for an exact gain
